highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.0 receives upstream fixes for GPU path bounds, clipping, and recorded glyph replay.
highlights_body: These updates retain Skia milestone 156 and leave managed APIs unchanged.

bullets.detail: Corrects Ganesh device-space path bounds and software coverage-mask subset clamping, plus Graphite clip-key packing and wedge miter bounds.

Validates serialized Slug positions, matrices, bounds, and flags; bounds direct-mask offsets and preserves creation-time rounding. Ganesh and Graphite retain rendering fallbacks when glyph data cannot safely use atlas bilinear sampling.
